replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

We have multiple amounts of evidence that Nova was playing on your account during the tournament.

a) Nova had a talk with Posighdun, and he claimed that he would ban evade in the tournament, which we suspected numerous amounts of EC players. Also, a player on EC's teamspeak claimed that Nova was going to ban evade on your account.

b) Multiple people kept saying comments related to Nova in the team channel
"I'll strat because nova can't talk"
"Nova?"

Clearly, whoever was Nova in the team channel couldn't talk so we narrowed down the list from there.

c) I moved you up to a staff lounge and asked you to talk to make sure that you weren't Nova. You said that you didn't have a mic at that time when there wasn't even a symbol next to your name to show it. When I moved you up again later, you said that you had a mic but it didn't work, so why did you lie in the first place? Saying that you didn't have a mic.

After a few hours, you got on teamspeak and told me that you can now talk because you got a new mic or you were using your moms, which I highly doubt. And this was after the matches

<19:589> "Saikron": theyre broken 2 weeks ago
<19:58:19> "Fouled": Ok
<19:58:28> "Fouled": What about it being broken
<19:58:37> "Saikron": my mum give me hes headphones now so can talk
<19:58:46> "Fouled": Ok

d) When you got on ts again, your ip had changed from when the matches were going on.
This could either mean
1) You restarted your internet (which I doubt)
2) The location changed

After we found out of all these facts, we had an official vote and decided to ban you and we don't really have any intentions to appeal you at this moment.

replies.author: Saikron
replies.body:
"Nova had a talk with Posighdun, and he claimed that he would ban evade in the tournament, which we suspected numerous amounts of EC players. Also, a player on EC's teamspeak claimed that Nova was going to ban evade on your account."

There`s no relation on what Novalikespevepe said and me, If a player said it has nothing to do with me, and seriously, I don`t think that`s true. If someone says that synix is ban evading with another account, you believe him even if you dont know who is him or why is him doing that?

Multiple people kept saying comments related to Nova in the team channel
"I'll strat because nova can't talk"

Nova was on an alternative ts, and he said the strats for each maps, but at the first match with cronus ( i think ) and he was not there (i dont know why) so Besta created the "strat". nova was just saying us the strat he created for each map

I moved you up to a staff lounge and asked you to talk to make sure that you weren't Nova. You said that you didn't have a mic at that time when there wasn't even a symbol next to your name to show it.

I had a mic, but it was broken, as you have clarified when you moved me the second time and when I was on eternal`s channel (yes the "static", you named like that). I had the "talk" botton activated everytime, I just muted when the "static" of my broken mic started disgusting my friends on eternal`s channel.

When I moved you up again later, you said that you had a mic but it didn't work, so why did you lie in the first place? Saying that you didn't have a mic.

Theres a difference of something you dont have or something you have but you cant even use? lol, you moved me because of the noice that you called it "static" when I tried to activate my mic, that you heard on eternals channel man... you told me: " If you dont activate your mic, I will ban you" when I connected it again you listened that creepy sound.


After a few hours, you got on teamspeak and told me that you can now talk because you got a new mic or you were using your moms, which I highly doubt. And this was after the matches

I live with my father, after some hours (when the tournament was finished) I come to my mothers home to see mexicos match vs chile. Then nova told me on skype to go inmediately to eternals teamspeak and he said that I got banned for "ban evasion", so he told me to get a mic and go to the avicus teamspeak and wait on the support room and ask why exactly I was banned and all, so I got my moms headphones (with mic, every good Iphone headphone has one) and you just told me to appeal on the forums and nothing else. That explains (i think) why my ip was "different" (i guess ip is the internet one).

So.. ( im writing this as you told me to ).

Why I should be unbanned: I played with my own account on battle of eternity.

Why I want to be unbanned: We had trained and waited and waited this tournament, I dont want to perjudicate my team and this is a huge new error.


Im been 100% honest, this is not the first time I have problems with the staff, on the second avicus tournament "race to victory", Eternal was dq because a official ( vobaseball ) said I had "aimbot", I upload my POV 15 minutes later, but he said "it is too late" and we got disqualified...

I taked this photo when I was play vs Jalapenos: https://gyazo.com/3271ed769880e681541a55263b1b5959
heres a photo of my launcher: https://gyazo.com/c8ab2f7439c621c5f0f7a291cf570026

I talk today with scaglia that was our referee of our matchs, we gave him our private ts and he was everytime there. novalikes talked to him that he was just going to give the strat and nothing else, and that is what he did, you can ask scaglia if you dont believe me, but im saying the truth.
This is all, if you tell me a way to demostrate (lol) that i was using my own account i will do it.

Thank you

pd: sorry for the bad english, some things are by google translator.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Ok so,

First, You said that your excuse for the "Nova" comments was that you guys were talking to Nova on another teamspeak. This is impossible as your mics would have been disabled on the other teamspeak.

Second, Nova was "stratting maps", but how does he strat maps without looking at them. It was stated that "Nova isn't here so I strat" - I being Besq. This obviously means Nova would have to be online to see the maps for him to create strats. This shows that Nova has connections with an account for ban evasion.

Third, I still don't understand why you lied about the mic. At first, you said that you didn't have a mic. Next time, you said it was broken, so you did have a mic.

Fourth, even if Nova was not ban evading on your account, EC would still have to face the penalties as Nova was on another teamspeak assisting you guys in the tournament. This goes against the tournament rules. There could have also been many options that can be considered as having an unfair advantage, such as a player livestreaming and nova watching it and providing you guys with strats.

You may create an appeal regarding this situation in 6-8 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Neyke
